title: Inner Illusion
subtitle: Test your understanding of Inner Illusion — the subrutean script, the cookie jar allegory, the space hoax, and the perceptual cage.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Deconstructing the internal subrutean script restores individual perceptual authority and the ability to reject manufactured consensus. Recognizing the space hoax collapses the false perception of cosmic insignificance and returns attention to the immediate physical plane. The cookie jar allegory shows why false intellectual pursuits waste energy, and why investigation belongs at the physical boundaries of the realm. Historical mapping validates flat-plane reality and the geography of Realm-2 beyond the ice wall.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the Inner Illusion within the human mind?

options.label: A
options.text: The Inner Illusion is a biological defense that shields the soul from external energetic interference.
options.rationale: It is a self-sustaining perceptual cage, and it does not protect the soul from interference.

options.label: B
options.text: The Inner Illusion synchronizes consciousness with the natural vibrations of the immediate physical realm.
options.rationale: It misdirects innate curiosity toward unattainable targets and obscures the true structure of the physical realm.

options.label: C
options.text: The Inner Illusion bridges the physical brain to the higher use of the 15 human attributes.
options.rationale: The illusion functions as a perceptual cage that turns the 15 human attributes against the soul.

options.label: D
options.text: Its primary function is to compel living souls to relinquish their innate decision-making processes, accept engineered consensus, and doubt their own perceptions.
options.rationale: Rather than relying strictly on physical force, this construct weaponizes human perception from early childhood so individuals conform to the NPC herd.

questions.hint: Consider how the mechanism affects self-trust and engineered agreement.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Subrutean” refers to the core set of innate human faculties—including pattern recognition and vivid imagination—that were inverted and weaponized to enforce psychological compliance.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: False — that description belongs to “15 Human Attributes”. The report defines “Subrutean” as: The internal subconscious or neurological receptacle at the back of the mind where engineered perceptual overlays and psychological programming take root.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “15 Human Attributes”, not “Subrutean”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Subrutean”.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Cookie Jar Allegory” refers to the inward-projected perceptual program reflected into a subrutean in the human mind that compels living souls to accept engineered consensus narratives and relinquish self-trust.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: False — that description belongs to “Inner Illusion”. The report defines “Cookie Jar Allegory” as: The foundational psychological programming model wherein human curiosity is permanently redirected toward an unreachable target while the true environment remains hidden in plain sight.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “Inner Illusion”, not “Cookie Jar Allegory”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Cookie Jar Allegory”.

questions.question: What was the original meaning of the cartographic designation Here Be Dragons?

options.label: A
options.text: Here Be Dragons was a myth used only to keep mariners from sailing far from the central continents.
options.rationale: Tartarian cartographers recorded actual sightings, and spherical models were what failed at sea.

options.label: B
options.text: Here Be Dragons records actual sightings of biological entities in Realm-2 beyond the ice wall.
options.rationale: Tartarian cartographers placed these designations at map peripheries to record those sightings.

options.label: C
options.text: Here Be Dragons warned explorers about the psychological danger of leaving the established herd.
options.rationale: The designation recorded biological entities, not an abstract warning about consensus.

options.label: D
options.text: Here Be Dragons marked the edge of an infinite vacuum of space around a spinning globe.
options.rationale: The mark belongs to flat-plane cartography and Realm-2 beyond the ice wall, not to the space hoax.

questions.hint: Consider what Tartarian map-makers recorded at the edges of their charts.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

options.label: A
options.text: Here Be Dragons — Historical cartographic designations placed at map peripheries by Tartarian cartographers to record actual sightings of biological entities in Realm-2 beyond the ice wall.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Here Be Dragons”.

options.label: B
options.text: Antarctic Treaty — The multi-generational construct that re-framed the firmament dome and flat plane as an infinite, empty vacuum of space to induce feelings of cosmic insignificance.
options.rationale: That description belongs to “Space Hoax”. The report defines “Antarctic Treaty” as: The 1959 global legal agreement enacted following the 1958 discovery of the firmament to enforce physical restriction to the southern boundary.

options.label: C
options.text: Inner Illusion — The inward-projected perceptual program reflected into a subrutean in the human mind that compels living souls to accept engineered consensus narratives and relinquish self-trust.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Inner Illusion”.

options.label: D
options.text: 15 Human Attributes — The core set of innate human faculties—including pattern recognition and vivid imagination—that were inverted and weaponized to enforce psychological compliance.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “15 Human Attributes”.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

questions.question: How does the space hoax induce a sense of cosmic insignificance?

options.label: A
options.text: The hoax teaches that the soul is too complex for the human mind to understand.
options.rationale: The hoax works through manufactured cosmic scale, not through the internal complexity of the soul.

options.label: B
options.text: The hoax treats the ice wall as a portal opening onto an infinite number of other globes.
options.rationale: The ice wall was eliminated from the public paradigm and replaced with a self-contained globe.

options.label: C
options.text: The hoax presents the firmament as a shield that living people are forbidden to approach.
options.rationale: The hoax re-framed the firmament dome and flat plane as an infinite, empty vacuum of space.

options.label: D
options.text: The space hoax re-framed the firmament dome and flat plane as an infinite, empty vacuum of space to induce feelings of cosmic insignificance.
options.rationale: This manufactured cosmic scale forces the individual to perceive themselves as microscopic and meaningless within an overwhelming reality.

questions.hint: Reflect on the effect of living as a tiny point inside an endless void.

questions.question: What occurs when the subconscious mind calculates a false ratio of consensus?

options.label: A
options.text: The subrutean then supplies a script that lets the soul identify digital inserts.
options.rationale: The script triggers isolation and self-doubt, and it coerces the soul back into the collective herd.

options.label: B
options.text: The imagination attribute activates so the NPC herd can receive new mythologies.
options.rationale: The false ratio is used to surrender authority to external constructs, not to generate new stories for the herd.

options.label: C
options.text: The living soul relinquishes personal decision-making and surrenders authority to external constructs.
options.rationale: A perspective shared by billions is treated as if it cannot be wrong, so the soul conforms to the NPC herd.

options.label: D
options.text: The individual develops a stronger trust in personal sensory perception.
options.rationale: The pressure causes the living soul to relinquish personal decision-making and doubt self-trust.

questions.hint: Consider the result of believing a view shared by billions cannot be wrong.

questions.question: Why were constellations intentionally arrayed across the celestial canopy?

options.label: A
options.text: Constellations mapped the territories that exist inside Realm-2 beyond the ice wall.
options.rationale: Realm-2 was recorded at map edges, while constellations redirected reverence toward celestial constructs.

options.label: B
options.text: Constellations signaled the firmament to people living along the peripheral ice wall.
options.rationale: The array exploited pattern recognition so human reverence left the physical plane.

options.label: C
options.text: Constellations were intentionally arrayed across the celestial canopy so human reverence was redirected away from the physical plane toward celestial constructs.
options.rationale: Human minds naturally project images, such as faces in clouds, onto arbitrary points of light, and that attribute was weaponized.

options.label: D
options.text: Constellations were a backup navigation system for mariners who lost their flat-plane charts.
options.rationale: Mariners depended on flat-plane charts because spherical geometry introduced fatal navigation errors.

questions.hint: Focus on the tendency to see faces in clouds and shapes in points of light.

questions.question: Why did mariners and navigators depend on flat-plane charts?

options.label: A
options.text: Tartarian law banned every chart that showed the realm as a spinning ball.
options.rationale: Flat-plane charts matched the understood physical reality of a flat plane enclosed by an ice wall.

options.label: B
options.text: Flat-plane maps were simply easier to draw and distribute than spherical globes.
options.rationale: The dependence followed from fatal navigation errors, not from how easy a chart was to print.

options.label: C
options.text: Mariners lacked the education required to understand the mathematics of a globe.
options.rationale: They depended on flat-plane charts because spherical navigation models failed at sea.

options.label: D
options.text: Mariners depended strictly on flat-plane charts because spherical geometry introduced fatal navigation errors.
options.rationale: Spherical navigation models failed at sea, so mariners navigated using flat-plane mapping systems.

questions.hint: Consider what happens when a curved model is used on a flat sea.

questions.question: How did removing the ice wall from the public paradigm affect exploration?

options.label: A
options.text: A global effort began to colonize the infinite vacuum of space.
options.rationale: Consciousness was directed upward into an unreachable void, and the immediate realm was left unexamined.

options.label: B
options.text: Explorers were encouraged to search for a way to break through the firmament.
options.rationale: The spinning globe presented the physical plane as a closed loop with no outer edge to seek.

options.label: C
options.text: A spinning globe presented the physical plane as a closed loop, removing any incentive to explore peripheral territories.
options.rationale: Omnidirectional travel merely returns an explorer to their starting point, so the ice wall left the public paradigm.

options.label: D
options.text: Mariners built new ships in order to sail over the edges of the flat plane.
options.rationale: The erasure removed the incentive to explore peripheral territories rather than inviting a crossing.

questions.hint: Think about the effect of believing every direction leads back to the start.

questions.question: Which outlets and figures were used to legitimize the scientific fictions of the space hoax?

options.label: A
options.text: The original mariners who navigated with flat-plane mapping systems legitimized the hoax.
options.rationale: Those mariners depended on flat-plane charts because spherical models failed at sea.

options.label: B
options.text: Living souls who resisted the subrutean script from early childhood legitimized the hoax.
options.rationale: Those souls are the ones the script tries to coerce back into the collective herd.

options.label: C
options.text: Independent Tartarian explorers using recovered map data legitimized the hoax.
options.rationale: Tartarian cartographers recorded Realm-2, and that knowledge was erased rather than used to support the hoax.

options.label: D
options.text: BBC Radio 4 was leveraged as a gold-standard authority, and Sir Patrick Moore legitimized the space hoax through The Sky at Night.
options.rationale: These outlets and figures validated scientific fictions and filled the public consciousness with astronomical fabrications.

questions.hint: Name the broadcasting channel and the long-running night-sky program.

questions.question: What do the multi-layered paints of illusory obfuscation represent?

options.label: A
options.text: The paints are physical camouflage hiding parasitic infrastructure inside Tartarian ruins.
options.rationale: The layers are cultural and institutional, and they function like thick coats of paint over human perception.

options.label: B
options.text: Millions of cultural and institutional layers were applied over human perception and function like thick coats of paint.
options.rationale: Television, academic degrees, and cultural status completely conceal the original truth beneath.

options.label: C
options.text: The paints are the stars and constellations used to decorate the celestial canopy.
options.rationale: Constellations weaponize pattern recognition, while the paints are the cultural and institutional layers laid over perception.

options.label: D
options.text: The paints are the diverse biological entities that inhabit the regions of Realm-2.
options.rationale: Realm-2 entities were recorded as Here Be Dragons, and the paints are manufactured layers of concealment.

questions.hint: Consider how television, academic degrees, and cultural status hide what is underneath.

questions.question: What is the result of recognizing the space hoax as a manufactured construct?

options.label: A
options.text: The individual grows more dependent on institutional science for spatial information.
options.rationale: Institutional science and media were deployed to reinforce the space construct that recognition rejects.

options.label: B
options.text: Recognizing the space hoax collapses the false perception of cosmic insignificance and refocuses human attention on the immediate physical plane.
options.rationale: Souls then search again for truth where they physically stand instead of in an unreachable void.

options.label: C
options.text: The subrutean answers with a stronger script that locks the soul into the NPC herd.
options.rationale: Recognizing the space hoax collapses cosmic insignificance rather than feeding the herd script.

options.label: D
options.text: The soul is carried at once into Realm-2 beyond the ice wall.
options.rationale: Recognition refocuses attention on the immediate physical plane, and it is not a physical crossing.

questions.hint: Think about what returns when the belief in an infinite empty void drops away.

questions.question: How does the subrutean script respond when a person detects a truth that contradicts the narrative?

options.label: A
options.text: The script shuts down pattern recognition so no further discovery is possible.
options.rationale: Pattern recognition is weaponized toward celestial constructs, while contradiction is met with self-doubt.

options.label: B
options.text: The script opens a clear path for the soul to carry that truth to other people.
options.rationale: The script coerces the soul back into alignment with the collective herd.

options.label: C
options.text: The subrutean script triggers feelings of isolation and self-doubt, coercing the soul back into alignment with the collective herd.
options.rationale: Living souls then automatically defer to external authority and majority consensus.

options.label: D
options.text: The script rewrites the consensus narrative so the new truth becomes the official view.
options.rationale: The script triggers isolation and self-doubt rather than absorbing the contradiction.

questions.hint: Consider the feelings used to pull someone back into the group.

questions.question: Which innate human capacity is targeted to anchor celestial mythologies?

options.label: A
options.text: The physical strength required to explore the southern ice boundary is the anchor.
options.rationale: Celestial mythologies are psychological, and the southern boundary was barred by the Antarctic Treaty.

options.label: B
options.text: The instinct to form a protective herd against biological entities from Realm-2 is the anchor.
options.rationale: The NPC herd is produced by engineered consensus, while mythologies are anchored by imagination.

options.label: C
options.text: The mechanism targets the pineal-driven capacity for imagination and pattern recognition to anchor celestial mythologies.
options.rationale: Vivid imagination and storytelling were weaponized so mortal curiosity became religious veneration of immortal stars.

options.label: D
options.text: The capacity to calculate spherical geometry for maritime navigation is the anchor.
options.rationale: Spherical geometry introduced fatal navigation errors, and mariners depended on flat-plane charts.

questions.hint: Look for the faculties that see images and tell stories.

questions.question: What is the strategic result of understanding the Cookie Jar Allegory?

options.label: A
options.text: It encourages people to dig more deeply into intellectual study, on the view that the answers lie hidden in the old texts and can be found by those who read widely enough.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The true environment remains hidden in plain sight once curiosity is no longer sent after an unreachable target.

options.label: B
options.text: It keeps souls from wasting energy on false intellectual pursuits and directs investigation toward the physical boundaries of the realm.
options.rationale: The true environment remains hidden in plain sight once curiosity is no longer sent after an unreachable target.

options.label: C
options.text: It teaches people to build taller ladders towards a target that keeps moving away.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The true environment remains hidden in plain sight once curiosity is no longer sent after an unreachable target.

options.label: D
options.text: It supplies the mathematical proof of the spinning ball model.
options.rationale: Not what the report says. The true environment remains hidden in plain sight once curiosity is no longer sent after an unreachable target.

questions.hint: Knowing a target is a distraction changes where the search goes.

questions.question: What was the Antarctic Treaty of 1959 enacted to achieve?

options.label: A
options.text: The Antarctic Treaty was enacted in 1959 to physically bar public access to the southern ice boundary.
options.rationale: It followed the discovery of the firmament in 1958 and keeps exploration from testing the globe assumption.

options.label: B
options.text: The treaty protects the biological entities of Realm-2 from human interference.
options.rationale: The treaty bars public access so psychological assumptions are never challenged by physical exploration.

options.label: C
options.text: The treaty coordinates a scientific expedition into the infinite vacuum of space.
options.rationale: The treaty followed the discovery of the firmament and concerns the southern ice boundary, not the vacuum.

options.label: D
options.text: The treaty forms a joint government between Tartarian survivors and modern nations.
options.rationale: It is a global legal agreement that enforces physical restriction to the southern boundary.

questions.hint: Focus on physical restriction at the southern boundary.

questions.question: How does the Simulation Field maintain the psychological lock on the human mind?

options.label: A
options.text: The Simulation Field supplies continuous physical proof that the globe model is accurate.
options.rationale: The globe is maintained by perceptual scripts and institutional layers, not by an open physical proof.

options.label: B
options.text: The Simulation Field projects live images of Realm-2 entities into the subrutean.
options.rationale: The ice wall and Realm-2 were erased from the public paradigm rather than projected into the mind.

options.label: C
options.text: The Simulation Field disables the pineal gland during early childhood conditioning.
options.rationale: The field exploits the pineal-driven capacity for imagination rather than switching the gland off.

options.label: D
options.text: The Simulation Field maintains this psychological lock by continuously reinforcing the perception of personal insignificance.
options.rationale: That reinforcement keeps souls from searching for truth where they physically stand.

questions.hint: Think about the persistent sense of being small and meaningless.

questions.question: What is the relationship between the Inner Illusion and the NPC herd?

options.label: A
options.text: The NPC herd uses the Inner Illusion to protect itself from the true structure of the realm.
options.rationale: The illusion uses the herd to trigger self-doubt, and the herd does not operate the illusion.

options.label: B
options.text: The manufactured consensus of the NPC herd is used to trigger self-doubt in true souls.
options.rationale: Digital Inserts and the high NPC ratio supply that consensus, and individuals then police their own thoughts.

options.label: C
options.text: The NPC herd is made of people who have already deconstructed the Inner Illusion.
options.rationale: The herd is the conformity the illusion produces when souls surrender to public consensus.

options.label: D
options.text: The Inner Illusion is a tool the NPC herd built in order to explore the ice wall.
options.rationale: The illusion removes the incentive to explore peripheral territories and conforms people to the herd.

questions.hint: Consider how a manufactured majority is used against a true soul.

questions.question: Why is physical force unnecessary for containment inside the Inner Illusion?

options.label: A
options.text: Force is unnecessary because the physical boundaries are naturally impassable to humans.
options.rationale: Containment works because individuals voluntarily police their own thoughts and surrender to public consensus.

options.label: B
options.text: Force is rendered unnecessary for containment because individuals voluntarily police their own thoughts and surrender to public consensus.
options.rationale: The living soul relinquishes personal decision-making and conforms to the NPC herd.

options.label: C
options.text: Force is unnecessary because the 15 human attributes have been deleted from the human genome.
options.rationale: Those faculties remain, and they were inverted and weaponized to enforce psychological compliance.

options.label: D
options.text: Force is unnecessary because every living soul has already been moved into Realm-2.
options.rationale: Souls remain in the immediate realm, and the cage keeps them from examining it.

questions.hint: Think about self-policing replacing an external guard.

questions.question: How did the erasure of flat-plane reality affect Tartarian energy infrastructure?

options.label: A
options.text: Tartarian infrastructure was built to stop the public from discovering the ice wall.
options.rationale: Tartarian cartographers recorded the ice wall and Realm-2, and their networks were later obscured.

options.label: B
options.text: Tartarian energy infrastructure directly powered the Simulation Field and the space hoax.
options.rationale: The networks were obscured by the erasure of flat-plane physics, and they were not the power source of the hoax.

options.label: C
options.text: Tartarian infrastructure supplied the material used to build the firmament dome in 1958.
options.rationale: The firmament was discovered in 1958, and it was not constructed that year from Tartarian works.

options.label: D
options.text: The erasure of flat-plane physics simultaneously obscured Tartarian harmonic architecture and aetheric power networks.
options.rationale: That lateral connection hides Tartarian energy infrastructure together with the true geography of the realm.

questions.hint: Consider what was hidden together with the true geography.

questions.question: How does the space hoax direct human consciousness?

options.label: A
options.text: The hoax directs consciousness inward so the subrutean scripts can be read and removed.
options.rationale: The hoax sends attention upward into an unreachable void rather than inward toward the script.

options.label: B
options.text: Human consciousness is directed upward into an unreachable void, leaving the immediate realm unexamined.
options.rationale: Souls cease searching for truth or discovery where they physically stand.

options.label: C
options.text: The hoax directs consciousness toward the southern ice boundary so the Antarctic Treaty stays visible.
options.rationale: The treaty bars public access to that boundary, and the hoax keeps attention off it.

options.label: D
options.text: The hoax directs consciousness horizontally toward the discovery of Realm-2.
options.rationale: The hoax removes any incentive to explore peripheral territories beyond the ice wall.

questions.hint: Name the direction attention is sent, and what is left unexamined.

questions.question: What is the significance of the year 1958 for the Inner Illusion?

options.label: A
options.text: In 1958 Tartarian survivors drafted the Antarctic Treaty for the first time.
options.rationale: The Antarctic Treaty was enacted in 1959 to enforce physical restriction to the southern boundary.

options.label: B
options.text: The firmament was discovered in 1958, leading to physical restrictions at the southern ice boundary.
options.rationale: The Antarctic Treaty was enacted in 1959 to physically bar public access to that boundary.

options.label: C
options.text: In 1958 The Sky at Night began and thereby created the firmament story.
options.rationale: Sir Patrick Moore used that program to legitimize the space hoax, while 1958 is the firmament discovery.

options.label: D
options.text: In 1958 a navigator completed the first circuit of the entire globe.
options.rationale: That year is the discovery of the firmament, which the globe model was built to conceal.

questions.hint: Name the physical discovery that came just before the 1959 treaty.

questions.question: What is the result of deconstructing the internal subrutean script?

options.label: A
options.text: Deconstruction forces the soul to adopt a replacement engineered consensus in order to survive.
options.rationale: The result is the ability to reject manufactured consensus, not to accept a new one.

options.label: B
options.text: Deconstruction activates the Simulation Field's physical containment protocols.
options.rationale: Deconstruction restores perceptual authority rather than calling down a new physical lock.

options.label: C
options.text: Deconstructing the internal subrutean script restores individual perceptual authority, enabling living souls to reject manufactured consensus.
options.rationale: Living souls can then trust perception instead of deferring automatically to external authority.

options.label: D
options.text: Deconstruction turns the 15 human attributes against the soul on a permanent basis.
options.rationale: The illusion already turns those attributes against the soul, and deconstruction restores authority over them.

questions.hint: Consider what returns when the internal programming is taken down.

questions.question: How does the Inner Illusion use the 15 human attributes?

options.label: A
options.text: The illusion develops the attributes fully so souls can leave the physical realm.
options.rationale: The attributes are used to enforce psychological compliance inside a perceptual cage.

options.label: B
options.text: The 15 human attributes were inverted and weaponized to enforce psychological compliance.
options.rationale: The illusion functions as a self-sustaining perceptual cage that turns the 15 human attributes against the soul.

options.label: C
options.text: The illusion suppresses the attributes entirely and leaves humans as mindless biological machines.
options.rationale: The attributes remain, and they were inverted and weaponized rather than deleted.

options.label: D
options.text: The illusion uses the attributes only to check the astronomical claims of the space hoax.
options.rationale: Pattern recognition and imagination were weaponized to create veneration, not to test the hoax.

questions.hint: Ask whether those faculties are deleted or turned around.
